title: delphinium incisum

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may also have anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
